status: These exact workspace rows were read from the successful test/benchmark job. The same workflow's native host later exposed an asynchronous TextChanged observation error in the new test; that test was corrected in a subsequent commit. Benchmark success is not a claim that this entire historical workflow passed.
methodology: Current-thread managed allocations and CPU Stopwatch measurements. Diagnostic projection rebuilding versus returning a retained immutable array measures avoiding repeated work, not faster construction. Glyph comparison records and replays the same NEW geometry per draw versus reusing a picture; it is NOT a reproduction of the preceding EditorIcon implementation. Bitmap is CPU 16x16, 1000 draws per sample. Cached warmup/recording excluded; retained native picture memory, other-thread allocations, layout/UI/compositor, physical GPU and end-to-end latency are not measured.

rows.note: Zero rounded elapsed samples are below timer/report resolution, not literally zero execution time. Fresh projection construction and filtered queries still cost work.
